sync.label: Enable cloud sync (multiple devices)
sync.hint: Leave it off for local-only use. When on, settings and conversations are pushed to the host and take effect on the next start.

memory.title: Character memory
memory.intro: The character extracts long-term memory from the conversation (L1 events / L2 conclusions) and recalls it by topic when building a reply; matching knowledge-base documents ride along with the request. Everything lives in the unified store (local SQLite / self-hosted D1) and follows the host's sync. With the master switch off, nothing is extracted or injected.
memory.vecEnabled: Enable vector recall (loads a local embedding model on first use; off means keyword/entity matching only)
memory.injectCharsHint: Total character budget for knowledge chunks
memory.autoWrite: Write memory after every turn (one extra extraction call per turn, billed)
memory.tip: Auto-write is off by default: with it on, every completed turn sends one extra extraction request (billed to your model account). The vector leg loads its model only the first time you enable it, and falls back to keyword search if that fails.

compact.title: Context compaction
compact.intro: Long conversations trigger automatic compaction: early messages are folded into a story summary and later requests carry the summary plus the last few turns verbatim. Either trigger is enough — the message count reaching its threshold, or the conversation's estimated tokens reaching a share of the context window. Summaries are stored per conversation and never leak into another one.
compact.ratioHint: Share of the context window (0.3-0.95, default 0.7)
compact.tip: A successful compaction calls the summary model once (it costs money). A lower ratio compacts earlier and saves more context, but drops the original text sooner; conversations under 5 messages never trigger.

card.intro: Deploy OwnChat to your own Cloudflare Worker or VPS (Docker + Caddy TLS); the host profile is written back when the run finishes.
card.gate: The deploy wizard is not available for this profile: it needs a signed-in account, a desktop host, or a self-hosted host.

card.title: Data backup
card.intro: Packs the unified store — session events, messages, summaries, character cards, memory, knowledge base, workspaces, attachments and the gallery — into one ZIP. API keys, UI settings and sync cursors are not included. Importing replaces local data and rebuilds the message index from the event log.
card.includeKv: Also export the local hot window (native_kv; secret, settings and sync-cursor namespaces are skipped automatically)
card.tip: Export a current backup before importing. A table over 500,000 rows or 200 MB is refused outright (never silently truncated); a failed import rolls back to the pre-import data.
